name: PixaVector
title: PixaVector User Manual
scope: Product workflows, account access, recovery and updates. Source-backed tool tours are included where a registered tool catalog is connected; this is not a complete reference for every editor command.

chapters.title: Start a first project
chapters.body: Start with a simple shape or a copy of an existing vector document. Open Help → PixaVector User Manual or the Manual footer button for offline instructions. Help → Quick Tool Tour walks through all 92 registered tools; Next, Back, Finish and Escape control the read-only bubbles. Visible toolbar groups are highlighted without changing your active tool or document.

chapters.title: Make a first edit
chapters.body: Use selection to choose an object, then adjust its position, shape, fill and stroke. Keep separate objects for elements you may want to change later.

chapters.title: Keep your work organized
chapters.body: Use layers and groups to keep related artwork together. Check object order when one shape hides another.

chapters.title: Save and export
chapters.body: Keep an editable project copy. Export a separate copy in the format needed by the person or service receiving your artwork. If the device access refresh fails, keep the app open and use Save recovery copy to choose a destination. Reconnect before closing if you have unfinished text fields or background operations. Open the recovered native files in the editor after reconnecting; retain the original files.

chapters.title: Your account
chapters.body: Use Your account in the Pixa footer to connect this device. Pixa is free early access with no card requirement and no scheduled account expiration. Only approve the code displayed on your own device. Device access refreshes online; a disconnected, revoked or signed-out device must reconnect. Your files remain local.

chapters.title: Updates
chapters.body: Use Updates in the Pixa footer to check the Pixa publisher feed. On Mac, download the candidate, save your work and choose Install and restart. The app checks the installer digest, Apple publisher signature, bundle identity and Gatekeeper before replacement. A canceled editor-close prompt cancels the pending restart. Windows and Linux open the Pixa download page. No update is offered until a matching publisher release exists. PixaVector checks its own publisher feed in the background once at startup. An available matching update opens the Updates window; downloading and installation still require your choice.

chapters.title: Find your way around
chapters.body: The menu bar and editor panels contain the main controls. Use the existing workspace controls to show a hidden panel. Manual and Quick tour in the Pixa footer reopen this help without changing the project.

chapters.title: Undo and safe experiments
chapters.body: Use Undo to reverse a normal document edit, and Redo to restore it. Keep an original project or duplicate before destructive operations. Undo does not reverse an external file deletion, a published upload or every background operation.

chapters.title: Linked files and portability
chapters.body: An editable project may refer to media, fonts, textures or other external files. Keep those resources alongside your project in a stable folder. Copy the complete folder when moving computers and reopen it before removing the original.

chapters.title: Working with another application
chapters.body: Save a native editable copy before exporting an interchange format. Features such as effects, fonts and linked resources may differ in another application. Reopen exported files in the destination application before relying on them.

chapters.title: Recovery and backups
chapters.body: Save regularly and keep a separate backup of important projects and original media. Recovery copies contain committed project state; unfinished text fields, external files and background tasks may need separate attention. Restore into a new project or folder rather than overwriting the original.

chapters.title: Troubleshooting
chapters.body: For missing content, check the active document, selected object, visible panels, layers and linked-file paths. For account problems, reconnect in Your account. For failed updates, keep the existing application and use the verified Pixa download page; do not disable operating-system security checks.

tools.title: Selection Tool
tools.body: Select and transform whole objects. Drag a selection boundary or use the properties panel for exact values. Default shortcut: V. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Direct Selection Tool
tools.body: Select individual anchor points or path segments for precise shape edits. Default shortcut: A. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Group Selection Tool
tools.body: Select an object within a group without ungrouping the artwork.

tools.title: Magic Wand Tool
tools.body: Select objects with matching visual attributes, using the tool's tolerance settings. Default shortcut: Y. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Lasso Tool
tools.body: Draw around anchor points or objects to select them. Default shortcut: Q. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Pen Tool
tools.body: Place anchor points and drag direction handles to draw an editable path. Default shortcut: P. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Add Anchor Point Tool
tools.body: Add an anchor to an existing path segment for finer control. Default shortcut: +. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Delete Anchor Point Tool
tools.body: Remove an anchor from a path. Inspect the curve after the change. Default shortcut: -. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Anchor Point Tool
tools.body: Convert a point between a corner and a smooth curve, or edit its handles. Default shortcut: Shift+C. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Curvature Tool
tools.body: Draw and reshape curved paths by placing curve points. Default shortcut: Shift+~. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Type Tool
tools.body: Create and edit point text. Default shortcut: T. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Area Type Tool
tools.body: Put text inside a closed area so it wraps within the shape.

tools.title: Type on a Path Tool
tools.body: Place text along a path and adjust its position on that path.

tools.title: Vertical Type Tool
tools.body: Create point text with a vertical writing direction.

tools.title: Vertical Area Type Tool
tools.body: Flow vertical text inside a closed area.

tools.title: Vertical Type on a Path Tool
tools.body: Place vertically oriented text along a path.

tools.title: Touch Type Tool
tools.body: Adjust individual characters' position, rotation or scale within text. Default shortcut: Shift+T. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Line Segment Tool
tools.body: Draw a straight line segment. Default shortcut: \. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Arc Tool
tools.body: Draw an editable arc.

tools.title: Spiral Tool
tools.body: Draw a spiral and adjust its geometry.

tools.title: Rectangular Grid Tool
tools.body: Draw a rectangular arrangement of grid lines.

tools.title: Polar Grid Tool
tools.body: Draw a circular grid with radial and concentric divisions.

tools.title: Rectangle Tool
tools.body: Draw a rectangle and adjust its dimensions. Default shortcut: M. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Rounded Rectangle Tool
tools.body: Draw a rectangle with rounded corners.

tools.title: Ellipse Tool
tools.body: Draw an ellipse or circle. Default shortcut: L. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Polygon Tool
tools.body: Draw a regular polygon.

tools.title: Star Tool
tools.body: Draw a star with adjustable point geometry.

tools.title: Flare Tool
tools.body: Create a flare-style vector object and adjust its appearance.

tools.title: Paintbrush Tool
tools.body: Draw a path using the selected brush appearance. Default shortcut: B. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Blob Brush Tool
tools.body: Paint filled vector shapes that can combine with compatible nearby regions. Default shortcut: Shift+B. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Shaper Tool
tools.body: Sketch gestures to form or combine vector shapes. Default shortcut: Shift+N. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Pencil Tool
tools.body: Draw a freehand path that remains editable as vector geometry. Default shortcut: N. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Smooth Tool
tools.body: Reduce abrupt bends along an existing path.

tools.title: Path Eraser Tool
tools.body: Erase part of a selected path rather than erasing raster pixels.

tools.title: Join Tool
tools.body: Connect compatible path ends. Select the intended open ends first.

tools.title: Eraser Tool
tools.body: Remove regions from selected vector artwork. Default shortcut: Shift+E. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Scissors Tool
tools.body: Split a path at a chosen point. Default shortcut: C. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Knife
tools.body: Cut vector shapes along a drawn cutting stroke.

tools.title: Mirror & Cut Tool
tools.body: Cut artwork using a mirrored cutting operation.

tools.title: Line Cut Tool
tools.body: Cut artwork along a straight line.

tools.title: Rectangle Cut Tool
tools.body: Cut artwork using a rectangular region.

tools.title: Rotate Tool
tools.body: Rotate selected artwork around a reference point. Default shortcut: R. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Reflect Tool
tools.body: Mirror selected artwork about an axis. Default shortcut: O. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Scale Tool
tools.body: Change selected artwork's size. Check aspect-ratio constraints before dragging. Default shortcut: S. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Shear Tool
tools.body: Slant selected artwork while preserving straight edges.

tools.title: Reshape Tool
tools.body: Adjust the shape of a selected path by moving a region of its geometry.

tools.title: Width Tool
tools.body: Vary stroke width along a path. Default shortcut: Shift+W. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Warp Tool
tools.body: Push or pull the outline of vector artwork with a distortion brush. Default shortcut: Shift+R. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Twirl Tool
tools.body: Twist nearby vector geometry around the pointer.

tools.title: Pucker Tool
tools.body: Pull nearby vector geometry inward.

tools.title: Bloat Tool
tools.body: Push nearby vector geometry outward.

tools.title: Scallop Tool
tools.body: Add repeated rounded distortions along an outline.

tools.title: Crystallize Tool
tools.body: Create pointed distortions along an outline.

tools.title: Wrinkle Tool
tools.body: Create irregular ripples in an outline.

tools.title: Free Transform Tool
tools.body: Move, scale, rotate or distort a selected object with transform handles. Default shortcut: E. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Puppet Warp Tool
tools.body: Place and move pins to deform artwork locally.

tools.title: Shape Builder Tool
tools.body: Combine or remove overlapping regions of selected shapes. Default shortcut: Shift+M. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Live Paint Bucket
tools.body: Fill regions in a live-paint arrangement with the chosen color or appearance. Default shortcut: K. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Live Paint Selection Tool
tools.body: Select individual live-paint regions or edges. Default shortcut: Shift+L. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Perspective Grid Tool
tools.body: Set up a perspective grid to guide artwork placement. Default shortcut: Shift+P. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Perspective Selection Tool
tools.body: Move or scale artwork in relation to the perspective grid. Default shortcut: Shift+V. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Mesh Tool
tools.body: Create or edit mesh points that control smooth color transitions. Default shortcut: U. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Gradient Tool
tools.body: Create or adjust a gradient's direction, stops and spread. Default shortcut: G. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Eyedropper Tool
tools.body: Sample supported appearance attributes from another object. Default shortcut: I. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Measure Tool
tools.body: Measure the distance and angle between points.

tools.title: Blend Tool
tools.body: Create intermediate artwork between selected objects. Default shortcut: W. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Objects on Path Tool
tools.body: Arrange repeated objects along a path.

tools.title: Dimension Tool
tools.body: Place dimension annotations on measured geometry.

tools.title: Symbol Sprayer Tool
tools.body: Place multiple instances of a symbol. Default shortcut: Shift+S. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Symbol Shifter Tool
tools.body: Move symbol instances within a symbol set.

tools.title: Symbol Scruncher Tool
tools.body: Move symbol instances closer together or farther apart.

tools.title: Symbol Sizer Tool
tools.body: Change the size of symbol instances.

tools.title: Symbol Spinner Tool
tools.body: Change symbol instances' rotation.

tools.title: Symbol Stainer Tool
tools.body: Tint symbol instances with the selected color.

tools.title: Symbol Screener Tool
tools.body: Adjust symbol instances' opacity.

tools.title: Symbol Styler Tool
tools.body: Apply appearance styles to symbol instances.

tools.title: Column Graph Tool
tools.body: Create a graph with vertical columns from entered data. Default shortcut: J. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Stacked Column Graph Tool
tools.body: Create vertical columns divided into stacked data series.

tools.title: Bar Graph Tool
tools.body: Create a graph with horizontal bars.

tools.title: Stacked Bar Graph Tool
tools.body: Create horizontal bars divided into stacked data series.

tools.title: Line Graph Tool
tools.body: Plot data series as connected lines.

tools.title: Area Graph Tool
tools.body: Plot data series as filled areas.

tools.title: Scatter Graph Tool
tools.body: Plot pairs of numeric values as points.

tools.title: Pie Graph Tool
tools.body: Display data proportions as pie segments.

tools.title: Radar Graph Tool
tools.body: Compare values along axes radiating from a common center.

tools.title: Artboard Tool
tools.body: Create and resize artboards that define separate output areas. Default shortcut: Shift+O. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Slice Tool
tools.body: Mark an output slice within the artwork. Default shortcut: Shift+K. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Slice Selection Tool
tools.body: Select and adjust existing output slices.

tools.title: Hand Tool
tools.body: Pan the canvas without moving artwork. Default shortcut: H. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Rotate View Tool
tools.body: Rotate the canvas view without rotating the artwork. Default shortcut: Shift+H. Custom keymaps may differ.

tools.title: Print Tiling Tool
tools.body: Adjust how the artwork is divided across printed pages.

tools.title: Zoom Tool
tools.body: Change view magnification without changing document resolution or geometry. Default shortcut: Z. Custom keymaps may differ.
